routes.name: edit the resource data itself
routes.how: research/ui/tools/nbu_probe/nbu_format.py: split a resource set into its length-delimited records, change them, join() back. The allocation header (0x10002) and the image arrays (0x1000B) are the two records a new row has to touch, plus the controller max at 0xC1A709BC
routes.cost: no hooks at all for the edit itself -- but the edited set still needs a load path, and the per-field grammar of a record body is only partly decoded
routes.gets: real authoring: 221 sets, 303,597 records, all of them addressable, editable and re-emittable byte-exactly
routes.does_not: get the edited set into the camera by itself: that is R3 (the resource-directory redirect), whose record fields are still untraced
routes.verified: offline: 220 of 220 adjacent sets tile exactly; MainB2's 1392 boundaries match the firmware's own parse and re-emit byte for byte

routes.name: enum->state pair table
routes.how: write 0xC2E4020C; read on every evaluation by 0xC06CCD10
routes.gets: a display state switch, immediately, next draw
routes.does_not: create artwork or a menu row

routes.name: private NBR + guarded record copies
routes.how: 3 Thumb hooks (0xC05E84D8 load, 0xC05E6400 parse, 0xC05E5B58 strings); register a private pack once, then for each target record: match address + FNV-1a of the original bytes, copy into a bounded 512-byte buffer, append the new state and ALL companion properties, let the stock interpreter parse the copy
routes.cost: ~2.5k words + a pack; every companion property must be cloned (visibility, rectangle, position, collapse, cursor, timeline) or the tile draws corrupted
routes.gets: real native rows, Quick Set tiles, footer strips, collapsed summaries
routes.does_not: replay a record that was already consumed -- a zero target-hit bitmap is a TIMING miss, not a drawing failure
routes.verified: camera (FP3K v0.3.2, fpsup-og3k v0.2.x, fpsup-formats v0.3.0a)

routes.name: repoint a resource in the NBR directory
routes.how: write 8 bytes at a directory entry +0x08 (data offset from 0xC0D22400, and size) so the stock loader picks up your bytes instead; tools/nbr_stock.py prints the exact write
routes.cost: 8 bytes per resource plus the new bytes, both journalled and restored at power-off
routes.gets: any icon, font or MENU LIST CSV replaced, including with something LONGER. The whole menu is 195 .cvm files whose columns are named by their own header line; Enabled/Enabled2 = 1,2 selectable and 0,0 greyed, and the _excl variants are pre-baked grey-out versions. A TEXT cell may be a literal string, so a new row needs no change to the 17 .nloc tables
routes.does_not: make a new row selectable on its own (the Settings controller max at 0xC1A709BC has to grow) or draw a new tile (that needs the NBU side: image array 0x1000B plus every companion property plus the allocation header)
routes.verified: offline, and it reproduces fpSup-Formats' camera-verified 8-byte patch byte for byte

routes.name: post-parse tile fallback
routes.how: three layers: observe 0xC05E37F8 for a real time-66 endpoint, then hook 0xC05E2970 to swap in UNIQUE synthetic image names for the exact groups, then serve those names at 0xC0602098
routes.cost: three hooks, only covers the active 20/21 tiles
routes.gets: a tile on a screen that was already parsed
routes.does_not: cover the footer slot, cursor range or the collapsed summary

routes.name: donor-row reparenting
routes.how: take a stock two-option wrapper (Y4_4_STILL 0xC216C8B8), reparent it to the MainB2 root 116, remap ids, rewrite position/visibility/text/List bounds, bind a PRIVATE registered variable (0xC05DB308)
routes.cost: large offline recipe, every field individually pinned
routes.gets: a genuinely new setting, not a new value of an existing one
routes.does_not: exist on a camera yet; focus behaviour, allocator capacity, timing and failure cleanup unverified

routes.name: draw over the UI instead of in it
routes.how: `display text` / `display osd` / `display faceframe` / `display osdfile`, or a cave veneer on the display submit 0xC02E8A08
routes.gets: text, rectangles, bitmaps, a false-colour scale, a boot banner
routes.does_not: look native, survive arbitrary redraws without an observer, or appear in menus
routes.verified: camera (both this project and two third parties)

emulated.what: the record interpreter itself, over the real container. Established: tokens are BIG-ENDIAN u32; EVERY record is {u32 tag, u32 size, body} with size counting the header, so a set can be split, edited and re-emitted with no per-tag grammar; the top level holds only the string pool (tag 1, pool base 0xC18C0474) and a 221-entry resource-set index (tag 0x10001); tag 0x10002 is the allocation header (MainB2: 3028 bytes, 23 classes, 193 objectBase); tag 0x1000B is the image array (the 'case 10' of README 5c -- the only tag that calls FUN_c05e2988). Pure-Python codec in nbu_format.py splits all 221 sets and 303,597 records in 0.4 s, and all 220 adjacent sets tile exactly; MainB2 round-trips byte for byte and its 1392 boundaries equal the firmware's
private-variable registration, lookup, vector/map growth, hashing, sorting -- pinned original Thumb under unicorn with synthetic app/registry and substituted allocator, Lua wrapper and strcmp
why callback errors cannot veto native assignment, and why unsubscribe alone cannot retire callback storage
the loader/stage2/payload harness: real firmware image, Python-substituted firmware routines. Skill: fp-unicorn-emulation

traps.what: `gui image log` spans more than one frame and the first draw after a state change still carries the PREVIOUS state's icons. Close -> change -> wait 3 s -> open (discard) -> close -> clear log -> open (measure). Cross-check by probing the other state first
eight parsed element copies were patched and read back correct, then a 144 MB sweep found none of them: the screen object that owned them had been freed. They were NOT rebuilt per draw

traps.trap: image property alone is not a state

reusing a stock `_2` name leaves the cached backend with no reason to decode again -- synthetic names must be UNIQUE
enter with B.W (T4), never BL, so lr still holds the original caller's return address; avoid bl between local labels (R_ARM_THM_CALL is not implemented); return with bx to a Thumb address
`key CAPTUREON` can dismiss the Quick Set overlay; use `display capture <path> 3 2` with retries=0 and confirm the file with `dir`. The main layer is ARGB4444, NOT L8A8
every element of a Quick Set draw comes from 0xC05E7300 with the same allocator, so a hook on the constructor cannot discriminate widgets; discriminate at the append (0xC05E2CA8) by elem+0x18
